identityTradability.exchangeName: Mobileye Global Inc. - Class A Common Stock

structural-causal.name: alignment2036
structural-causal.basis: ADAS, autonomy and physical AI address safety, mobility and labor automation.

structural-causal.name: crossDivisionLeverage
structural-causal.basis: Perception/AI/safety engineering may transfer across ADAS, robotaxi and humanoids, but operations and hardware differ materially.

structural-causal.name: scenarioRobustness
structural-causal.basis: Core ADAS provides an installed-base anchor while new robotaxi/humanoid businesses add optionality and execution risk.

structural-causal.name: substitutionResilience
structural-causal.basis: OEM integration and installed EyeQ base help, but automakers and rival autonomy stacks can substitute.

discovery-weak-signals.name: Physical AI optionality
discovery-weak-signals.basis: ADAS base is being extended into humanoid robotics and robotaxi operations, creating upside but also execution complexity.

adversarial-red-team.name: financialOperatingMomentum
adversarial-red-team.basis: Cash generation and guidance are positive, but Q2 revenue was flat and incentive accounting drove much of margin improvement.

adversarial-red-team.name: governancePower
adversarial-red-team.basis: Intel retains majority ownership, creating a controlling-shareholder consideration for public holders.

adversarial-red-team.name: crossDivisionLeverage
adversarial-red-team.basis: Physical-AI adjacency may create leverage but also risks management/capital dispersion.

adversarial-red-team.name: pricingPower
adversarial-red-team.basis: Q2 EyeQ ASP declined partly from higher China OEM mix.

expectations-execution.name: Execution quality
expectations-execution.basis: Guidance improved and losses narrowed, but revenue was flat and incentive effects must be separated from operating performance.
